title: Firms’ zero dividends ‘mismatch’ with Sara Duterte net worth | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Sara Duterte, Loren Legarda, Jackson Wang

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Prosecution: Sara Duterte firms’ zero dividends a ‘mismatch’ from her net worth

blocks.text: The prosecution examines Securities and Exchange Commission documents to establish that companies associated with Vice President Sara Duterte declared no dividends.

items: 16 votes or lower? Senators to hold caucus on Duterte impeachment voting threshold

blocks.text: Impeachment court spokesperson Reginald Tongol says the court may defer the voting on the conviction threshold of the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

items: Legarda extends medical leave until October 9

blocks.text: Senator Loren Legarda has again extended her medical leave, this time until October 9.

items: Trump administration prepares sanctions vs ICC, sources say

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump’s administration prepares sanctions against the entire International Criminal Court.

items: Jackson Wang dedicates ‘Thank You’ to fans

blocks.text: International pop star Jackson Wang releases his new single ‘Thank You’ and its music video Monday, September 21. – Rappler.com
